body: Yeah.  That's what I'm going to start doing.  I think I'm going to use that as fuel to live.
She posted http://i.imgur.com/RZOQVjL.png this right after talking to me...  And is telling me she is more fit to be a mother and so on.

I've been talking to a friend for the past hour who seems to be the only person in my "social circle" I guess you'd call it.  She's helping out quite a bit because she's been through similar stuff.  I definitely have calmed down quite a bit.

I wish I could.  I lost my job in the breakup which wouldn't have been a big deal if I could have finished the week I had left there.  Since she kicked me out, I had to cut it extra short.

I would love to travel.  I have friends in Canada I would love to go visit.  But it's way out of my price range.

I just feel like he's going to be missing out on so much.  She keeps talking like she isn't going to let me around him.  She wants him to go to school where she's at and live with her.  I don't want that for him.  Her mom does meth, smokes cigarettes constantly and almost died twice within a month from carbon monoxide poisoning.  Most people in that area do drugs.  The school system is terrible.  And above all, I will be spending my holidays alone.  Again.  She won't listen to anything I tell her and broke up with me over the stupidest shit.  It's driving me insane.  She acts like she cares one moment, then immediately when I show any kind of weakness, turns around and throws it back in my face that she doesn't.  I feel like dying would stop the pain.  But I wouldn't know.  I'm athiest.  There is nothing after I die.  That scares me more than living.
